title: Chess: castling (kingside and queenside)
description: Castle move for king+rook. Requirements: king hasn't moved, rook hasn't moved, no pieces between, king not in check, king doesn't pass through check, king doesn't land in check. Track has_moved flags per piece. Kingside: king e->g, rook h->f. Queenside: king e->c, rook a->d. Both colors.
close_reason: Castling kingside/queenside with all 6 requirements, has_moved tracking. 7 tests.
